Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the location of Bubblegum Alley in California as San Luis Obispo. The actual famous "Bubblegum Alley" (the public art installation similar to the Gum Wall) is located in **Los Angeles**, specifically at 700 N Alameda Street in the Arts District. While San Luis Obispo does have a "Bubblegum Alley" (a tourist attraction with gum on the walls), it is not the primary answer to the question asking for the location of the attraction "similar to Gum Wall," which typically refers to the Los Angeles landmark. The Planner failed to verify this distinction and proceeded to gather incorrect location data.
